text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I never thought I'd get injured
during training...
choice_data_list: Shall we call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, it only hurts a little!
Something like this will heal right away!
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself too hard isn't good, you hear.
Pushing yourself too hard isn't good, okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No, really, this is the least—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Just as you say, Trainer, it's best not to push myself too hard.

After treating the injury, I decided to play it safe
and have her rest for the day.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I was putting too much pressure on myself
just to become the best Umamusume in Japan...

After treating the injury, I decided to play it safe
and have her rest for the day.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not the kind of girl who gets discouraged by something like this!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My mom always said that 'scrapes and bruises are a kid's badges of honor.'

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—That's why this injury will surely become a badge of honor
for working hard to become the best in Japan one day!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Alright... In any case, I'll get this healed up
so I can resume training!

After finishing the treatment, I decided to resume training
at Special Week's request.
